title: Open-counit maps and predicates for binary coefficient-tower descent
statement: In the ordinary derived coefficient-tower setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian], [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf], [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude], [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], [lem-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-calculus] and [lem-sp-tower-binary-ctf-fibre], define good by inverse realization, in the tower coordinates of [def-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-interfaces], of the existing unnormalized constructible finite-Tor predicate; extension by the actual derived open extension; support U = extension U followed by F_h; and Represents by bijectivity on all good tests. Define nested as the actual open adjunction mate of the restricted unit through restrictionComp, and restrictedCounit by applying F_h to nested and then the original counit. For a binary open cover define coverA=j_W!M|W, coverB=j_U!M|U⊞j_V!M|V, coverComponent from the restriction compositor and nested, coverS as the (1,-1) biproduct lift, and coverT as the (1,1) descent of the actual open counits. Define LiftEquations as the two local counit equations, beta as the sum of the two local counits through the image projections, and OpenThetaEquation as the equality with local transposition under the actual open adjunction. These are the existing definitions moved verbatim to a shared definition module; no property is asserted.
